title: 第2407章 众城主的震惊第2406章 绿色魔骨
content_zh:
“这是体术吗？”
很少说话的吴穹，看到这一幕都忍不住发出了疑问。
他现在严重怀疑江平安使用的并非体术。
一招秒杀了大量同阶虫子，并且还制造了一种特殊的能量场，影响了其他虫子的状态。
这根本不是体术能够做到的。
“这些绿色金属……好像是他的骨头。”
林曼盯着旁边的绿色金属碎片分析，身前的粮仓因为震撼而剧烈起伏。
“他也修炼了《金衍神胎诀》？”
岳千峰下意识地想到了这门灵衍神殿的顶级神术。
郑赤焰表情严肃：“《金衍神胎诀》是将整个身躯锻造成神器，并不能操控骨头，而他能操控骨头变形、生长，这应该是他的某种特殊体修天赋。”
郑赤焰对《金衍神胎诀》很熟悉，立刻认出这并非《金衍神胎诀》。
他没想到江平安还隐藏着这种特殊天赋。
在之前的战斗中，对方果然有所隐藏。
没时间震惊，郑赤焰看到了希望，立刻对着另外三人下令：
“用法则护住身体，进入绿色能量场，击杀虫子！！”
江平安的骨头碎片上涌出了一种绿色能量体，形成了特殊的能量场。
这种奇怪规则力量，会对没有法则防护的虫子造成伤害，能大幅度削弱虫子的防御和力量。
此刻正是猎杀虫子的好时机！！
另外三人也从震惊中缓过神来，在身上笼罩上一层圣道规则，立刻冲入到能量场中。
虫子身体溃烂，防御减弱，攻击力量也大幅度降低。

他们趁此机会，忍着疲倦，疯狂收割这些虫子的性命。
江平安为了催动不灭魔骨，耗光了体内的太初之气，脸色有些发白，白中透绿。
不过，换来的效果极好。
与此同时，在山巅的众多城主，也注意到了这里的情况。
或者说，在江平安动用不灭魔骨的那一刻，上百个城主就感应到了。
这些修为高深、见过世面的城主，脸上浮现出了震惊，甚至恐惧的表情。
“幽鬼魔力！是幽鬼魔力！”
“幽鬼魔皇的后代混进来了吗？！”
“副殿主！快将此人抓住！！”
普通弟子或许并不知道什么是幽鬼魔力，也没听说过幽鬼魔皇。
但是，这群久居高位，活了漫长岁月的强者，却深知幽鬼魔力代表着什么。
曾经，道皇率领大军，联合数个道域，与幽鬼魔皇大战了漫长岁月，耗费了巨大代价才将幽鬼魔皇封印。
当时，他们道皇神域只剩下了一成生灵。
后来又花费了漫长岁月，才将幽鬼魔皇统治的神域清剿干净。
他们这批城主，大多是当时那段历史的见证者，大量亲人、朋友、爱人在那段岁月陨落。
没有经历过的人并不知道那段岁月的存在，只是知道那段历史而已，只有亲身经历的人，才知道那段历史的黑暗与可怕。
如今，外界或许还存在着一些零零散散的幽鬼魔皇后代，但是那些都不成气候。
而眼下，他们却看到了一个使用幽鬼魔力的人出现在了圣地！
就像你的仇敌突然出现在了你家里一样。
这导致很多城主直接应激了。

灵衍神殿的副殿主感应到幽鬼魔力出现的那一刻，也吓了一大跳。
不过，她很快便看透了真相，对着一些应激的城主淡淡说道：
content_en:
"Is this a physical technique?"
Wu Qiong, who seldom spoke, couldn't help but ask questions when he saw this scene.
He now seriously doubted that what Jiang Ping'an used was not physical skills.
One move instantly killed a large number of bugs of the same level, and also created a special energy field that affected the status of other bugs.
This is simply not something that physical skills can do.
"These green metals... seem to be his bones."
Lin Man stared at the green metal fragments next to him for analysis, and the granary in front of him heaved violently due to the shock.
"He also practiced the "Jin Yan Divine Embryo Technique"?"
Yue Qianfeng subconsciously thought of this top-notch magical skill in Lingyan Temple.
Zheng Chiyan's expression was serious: "The "Jin Yan Divine Embryo Technique" forges the entire body into a magical weapon. It cannot control the bones, but he can control the deformation and growth of the bones. This should be some kind of special physical talent of his."
Zheng Chiyan was very familiar with the "Jin Yan Divine Fetus Technique" and immediately recognized that this was not the "Jin Yan Divine Fetus Technique".
He didn't expect that Jiang Ping'an still had such a special talent hidden.
In the previous battle, the opponent really had something to hide.
There was no time to be shocked. Zheng Chiyan saw hope and immediately ordered the other three people:
"Use the law to protect your body, enter the green energy field, and kill the bugs!!"
A green energy body emerged from Jiang Ping'an's bone fragments, forming a special energy field.
This strange power of rules will cause harm to bugs without legal protection, and can greatly weaken the bugs' defense and strength.
Now is a great time to hunt bugs! !
The other three people also recovered from the shock, covered their bodies with a layer of Holy Law rules, and immediately rushed into the energy field.
The insect's body festers, its defenses weaken, and its attack power is greatly reduced.
They took this opportunity, endured their fatigue, and frantically harvested the lives of these insects.
In order to activate the immortal demon bone, Jiang Ping'an exhausted all the primordial energy in his body, and his face turned a little pale, white with green in it.
However, the results in exchange are excellent.
At the same time, many city lords on the top of the mountain also noticed the situation here.
In other words, the moment Jiang Pingan used the immortal demon bone, hundreds of city lords sensed it.
These city lords, who had advanced cultivation and had seen the world, had expressions of shock and even fear on their faces.
"Ghost magic! It's ghost magic!"
"Did the descendants of the Ghost Demon Emperor sneak in?!"
"Deputy Palace Master! Catch this person quickly!!"
Ordinary disciples may not know what ghost magic is, nor have they heard of the ghost demon emperor.
However, this group of strong men who have been in high positions and have lived for a long time know very well what the ghost's magic power represents.
Once upon a time, the Dao Emperor led an army and united several Dao realms to fight the Ghost Demon Emperor for a long time, and spent a huge price to seal the Ghost Demon Emperor.
At that time, only 10% of the creatures were left in their Dao Emperor Divine Realm.
Later, it took a long time to completely wipe out the divine domain ruled by the Ghost Demon King.
Most of these city lords were witnesses of that period of history, and a large number of relatives, friends, and lovers perished during those years.
People who have not experienced it do not know the existence of that period of time, they only know the history. Only those who have experienced it personally know the darkness and horror of that period of history.
Today, there may still be some scattered generations of ghosts and demon queens in the outside world, but those are nothing.
But now, they saw a person using ghost magic appearing in the Holy Land!
It's like your enemy suddenly shows up at your home.
This caused many city lords to become directly stressed.
The deputy master of Lingyan Temple was shocked when he sensed the ghost's magic power.
However, she soon saw through the truth and said calmly to some anxious city lords:
